title: Run OpenGL applications using the Zink driver
summary: Use the Zink driver to run OpenGL applications on top of Vulkan. This can help if you have issues with native OpenGL drivers or need OpenGL support on hardware that only supports Vulkan.

steps.explain: Set the MESA_LOADER_DRIVER_OVERRIDE variable to 'zink' when launching an application to force it to use the Zink driver.

placeholders.name: APPLICATION
placeholders.description: The command or path to the application you want to run.

alternatives.explain: For proprietary NVIDIA drivers, use additional environment variables to ensure Mesa/Zink is used.
